messages:
marta_fin: heads up — VentureTech submitted a billing dispute. They say we billed an extra burst on Feb 28 that their contractor already paid for. Asking for a retro credit + short-term Net60 while procurement sorts PO. can finance approve?
li_sales: VentureTech is small but strategic. what's the requested amount?
marta_fin: They uploaded invoice INV-2026-1432 and are asking for $9,800 credit (entire duplicate burst line). Also asking to shift next invoice to Net60.
billing-bot: Retrieved INV-2026-1432: 
```
Dedicated: 6 GPUs x 720h = $36,000
Burst (one-off): Burst compute charge = $9,800
Tax: $1,080
Total: $46,880
```
derrick_revops: FYI credits >$10k require VP signoff and comp ops review. $9,800 is under that threshold but still flags commission calculations. I'll open CO-4087 to log.
ana_legal: one-time credit ok, but need acknowledgement that this resolves the dispute and is non-precedential. if changing payment terms, we prefer Net45. any longer DSO needs AR sign-off.
chris_fpna: Finance discretionary limit is $10k for director approval. $9,800 is within that. Net60 increases DSO; recommend Net45 x1 instead. if sales insists on Net60, AR must sign off.
li_sales: customer asked specifically for Net60. VentureTech's procurement says they need Net60 this cycle only. they agreed to sign an ack that this is final. can we compromise: $9,800 credit + Net45 for next invoice and one-time Net60 if AR approves?
marta_fin: i can approve and create credit memo CM-2026-214 for $9,800 pending signed ack. apply once we have the email.
derrick_revops: CO-4087 created and linked to Deal Desk entry DDK-2026-221. comp ops note: potential commission claw if AE already booked commission on duplicated charge; will follow up.
nana_legal: drafted ack language: "Redwood will issue a one-time credit of $9,800 to invoice INV-2026-1432. This credit is non-recurring and resolves the referenced billing dispute in full. Payment terms for the next invoice will be Net45 unless Accounts Receivable approves Net60 in writing. Customer must sign and return." paste into email.
li_sales: sent to VentureTech, they signed the ack and said Net45 is fine. uploading signed email to Deal Desk now. :white_check_mark:
billing-bot: Action queued: create CM-2026-214 for $9,800 and apply to INV-2026-1432 after receipt of customer_ack_venturetech_2026-03-12.eml.
chris_fpna: Approved (internal): $9,800 credit + Net45 x1. Documented in DDK-2026-221. AR notified for any Net60 exception.
marta_fin: thanks everyone. i'll apply CM once the signed ack is attached and close the ticket.
derrick_revops: comp ops will follow up on commission bookkeeping; leaving CO-4087 open until resolved.
li_sales: great — saved the relationship. closing from sales side. :smile:
